rows.en: Exactly. Believe in your own sense of justice.
Looks like the Cube's merging has stopped. That should mean all the Gundam Heads are gone.
Still, you sure get sent off to all kinds of places, don't you?
Why not try searching all kinds of places? You might find something.
To think such a powerful kaiju has been revived... Be careful, okay?
As you are now, you're sure to win. But don't let your guard down.
Light is streaming from the stone pillars? It could be a trap.
Still, we can't move forward without defeating them. Stay on your guard.
So you defeated Zetton. That leaves only "Tyrant."
If things get dangerous, come back to base, all right?
You defeated all the kaiju!! But this is no time to be resting.
So Zamsha died... Somehow it makes me sad...
But thanks to him, you've got Belial cornered. Don't let his death be in vain!!
Exactly. We have to protect the world too.
What does this mean...? Wasn't "Regis" the name of this world?
I don't know. But one thing's certain: we have to stop Regis.
I'm counting on you. The future of the world rests in your hands.

notes.note: SPEAKERS from tools/talkspk.py Shop (Talk01_62-69); slice labels were all missing. Hikari = #0.697/707/720/730/731/742/767/778/779; Methuss = #0.708/709/719/743/754/755/765/766/777. #0.697 answers Methuss's #0.696 (don't be swayed by the enemy; you have no negative emotions).
'Kaiju' used for revived Ultra monsters, matching talk_008/009 base talk. Singular kaiju (number not marked in source).
Stone pillars plural: the story has three pillars guarded by King Pandon, Zetton and Tyrant; source does not mark number.
Inferred object: 'them' = the kaiju guarding the pillars (source drops the object). Subject 'we' restored.
Tyrant kept in quotes as the source brackets it.
Subject of 'cornered Belial' restored as 'you' (the heroes); Methuss stays at base.
Follows story MainEventMess0733 ('Isn't Regis what this world is called!?').
Source says 'that one/him' (yatsu); rendered as 'Regis' since 'it' would read as 'this world' after #0.777. Regis g=n.

report: 18/18 rows. Speakers from tools/talkspk.py Shop (Hikari/Methuss); all slice labels were missing. Inferred: #0.731 object = pillar-guarding kaiju; #0.766 subject 'you'; #0.778 'yatsu' rendered as 'Regis'. No new glossary names.
